# QR Code Generator

Vendored from the upstream project by Kazuhiko Arase on 2026-10-19:

- https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- `js/dist/qrcode.mjs` and `js/dist/qrcode.d.ts`
- MIT license: see `LICENSE`.

The small `qrcode.d.mts` file provides the ES module default-export signature used by this application. QR codes are generated locally without network requests.
